description: UK deadlines for a tax year (taxYear 2025 = 2025-26): tell HMRC by 5 October if new to Self Assessment, paper return 31 October, online return and balancing payment plus first payment on account 31 January, second payment on account 31 July; Making Tax Digital quarterly updates 1 (7 August) and 2 (7 November), with 3 and 4 not confirmed; Corporation Tax payment 9 months and 1 day after the accounting period and Company Tax Return 12 months after; VAT return and payment 1 calendar month and 7 days after the period. United Kingdom, as of 2026-11-21 (gov.uk and legislation.gov.uk). Income Tax bands are for England, Wales and Northern Ireland; Scottish bands are not calculated. General information and estimates only; not personal tax advice, no agent services and no filing with HMRC.
